tierReason: New tasks table, endpoints and member-based permissions; fits one cycle

decisions.decision: Due date picker uses @expo/ui/community/datetime-picker, no new dependency
decisions.why: @expo/ui is already installed and the SDK 58 docs say it is included in Expo Go

decisions.decision: Task and member 404s use the projects router's body (not_found, 'Project not found.')
decisions.why: Review finding: AC9 needs one identical body across task and member requests; reusing #5's message avoids changing a merged public API

decisions.decision: Task picker reads members through #5's member cache instead of a second copy
decisions.why: Review finding: two offline copies of members can drift; user chose to reuse #5's

decisions.decision: Cap a project at 1000 tasks by refusing the 1001st create (409 task_limit_reached) instead of paging the list
decisions.why: Review asked for a bounded list; paging is out of scope and silently truncating the list would hide tasks

findings.text: [sensitive] apps/api/src/tasks/routes.ts:257-263 + apps/api/src/members/routes.ts:166,186: removing/leaving a member keeps their TaskAssignee rows; a later PATCH sending the full assignee set (still containing the ex-member, who the picker can't untick) is refused 400 and rolls back the whole edit incl. title/status, so the task's assignees can never be changed again and queued edits are lost.

[sensitive] apps/api/src/tasks/routes.ts:168-171,229-232,282-286: membership/role checked outside the write transaction without lockProject; a member demoted/removed mid-request can still delete or assign (#5 fixed this race for projects).

[sensitive] apps/api/src/tasks/routes.ts:184-186: create reusing another project's task id returns 409 id_conflict, revealing the id exists elsewhere (low risk, random UUIDs); note as deliberate or use the 404.
[sensitive] migration renamed to 20261112060000_tasks: any DB that applied 20261112000000_tasks would fail deploy; change report should state rollback = drop TaskAssignee, Task, TaskStatus by hand.
[sensitive] apps/api/src/app.ts: tasks router mounted after /projects, so requireAuth runs twice per task request (two session lookups and lastUsedAt writes).
apps/mobile/src/tasks/StatusPicker.ts:23-31: on Android Alert keeps only 3 buttons, so Cancel is dropped and the alert can't be dismissed outside; use cancelable:true or a sheet.

apps/mobile/src/tasks/localChange.ts:9-19 (deriveMembers): former members still assigned on cached tasks are offered as pickable and start ticked in edit (formFromTask), leading to 400s on any assignee change.
apps/mobile/src/tasks/store.ts membersByProject + TasksProvider.refreshMembers: a second offline copy of members next to #5's members/memberCache.ts (members.cache.v1); copies can drift.
apps/api/src/tasks/routes.ts:110: task 404 message 'Not found.' differs from #5 members route 'Project not found.' (members/routes.ts:19); AC9 says task and member requests give the same body.
apps/mobile/src/tasks/TaskForm.tsx:274-286: description is multiline but Return submits (returnKeyType done, blurAndSubmit), so no line breaks in a 2000-char description.
[sensitive r2] apps/api/src/tasks/routes.ts:19-28: realDate accepts year 0000, which PostgreSQL DATE rejects, likely giving 500 instead of 400 (unverified); limit the year range.
[sensitive r2] apps/api/src/tasks/routes.ts:172-176: GET tasks list is unbounded (paging out of scope per spec); add a generous cap or note the exception in the change report.

[sensitive r2] routes.ts:279-283 + phone queue: a merged offline change with a newly added ex-member is refused whole (400), dropping title/status edits or an offline-created task; matches R3/R17 but is a data-loss tradeoff.
[sensitive r2] routes.ts:194-203: a retried create after the task was deleted elsewhere re-creates it (no tombstones, accepted by spec); note in Test Handoff.
[sensitive r2] rollout: db:deploy must run before the new API (member removal uses taskAssignee); undoing needs code revert before dropping tables; note in release notes.

[r2] apps/mobile/src/app/(app)/(home)/projects/[id]/tasks/index.tsx:51-58,78: refresh result is ignored; a failed first fetch (network/500) on an empty cache shows 'No tasks yet' with no error or retry (frontend checklist: error state, way forward).

[r2] apps/mobile/src/tasks/TaskCard.tsx:236-267: status pill is a pressable nested inside the accessible card pressable, so VoiceOver can't reach it; R23 status change from the card is impossible with a screen reader.

[r2] apps/mobile/src/tasks/DueField.tsx:114,140: on iOS the day picker opens on today but dueDate stays null until a change fires, so picking today then Done may save no date; set today when opening, as line 161 does for time.
[r2] apps/mobile/src/tasks/AssigneeField.tsx:334-343: multi-select rows reuse ChoiceRow with accessibilityRole radio; use checkbox.
[r3] apps/mobile/src/app/(app)/(home)/projects/[id]/tasks/index.tsx:131: Retry onPress={() => fetchTasks} returns the function without calling it, so Try again sends no request.

[r3] apps/mobile/src/tasks/outcomes.ts REASON_KEY/noticeKeys reuse project wording (errors.not_found 'That project no longer exists', errors.forbidden owner-only, create_failed 'project could not be created'); task 404, creator-or-owner 403, task_limit_reached 409 and id_conflict give wrong or misleading notices (R7, R28).

[r3] apps/mobile/src/tasks/validate.ts isRealDay + DueField.tsx picker: no 1900-9999 year check or min/max date, so the phone accepts dates the server refuses and an offline create is later dropped whole (R2, R27).
[r3] apps/mobile/src/tasks/syncCycle.ts pendingRefreshes(): marks cleared before refresh runs; if it returns offline, a refused change stays visible until the next refresh; re-mark on non-ok.

[sensitive r3] apps/api/src/tasks/routes.ts:298-299 (and the existing project schemas): a NUL character in title/description passes zod but PostgreSQL rejects it with 500, which the phone treats as temporary, so the change stays at the head of the shared queue and blocks all later syncs; refuse control characters with validation_failed.

[r4] apps/mobile/src/tasks/TasksProvider.tsx:228-229 still loops pendingRefreshes()+refresh, so the re-mark-on-offline fix in syncCycle.refreshPending (finding 23) never runs in the app; refused edits stay on screen after a failed refresh (R17).
[r4] apps/mobile/src/tasks/outcomes.ts:59-74: a create refused with 404 (project gone) says the task 'no longer exists'; needs create+not_found wording.
[r4] apps/api/src/http/text.ts:4-7, apps/mobile/src/lib/text.ts:3-4: C1 control characters U+0080-U+009F are not covered by the control-character rule.
[r4] apps/api/src/projects/routes.test.ts:126: refused-name characters test omits \r (task test has it).
